home.headline: Hike the Országos Kéktúra — one stamp at a time
home.subtitle: Mark stamping points and see your progress statistics.
home.testLoginEmail: Test login: any email (the account is created on first sign-in)
home.testLoginNote: Test server only. The data lives in the local test database.

dashboard.title: My progress
dashboard.mapLegend: Blue line — walked stretches (between two neighbouring stamped places), grey dashes — the rest.
dashboard.empty: No checkpoints loaded yet. Run supabase/seed.sql.
dashboard.extraNote: Unofficial stamps near the trail (castles, museums, other hiking movements). Not counted in the main total. Source: heyjoe.hu.
dashboard.restaurantDist: {km} km from the trail as the crow flies
dashboard.stageHint: “Stamp stage” marks every stamp of the stage plus its starting point; “Clear stage” removes only the stage's own stamps.
dashboard.routePickTo: Now pick the end stamp: “Route to here”.
dashboard.routePickFrom: Now pick the start stamp: “Route from here”.
dashboard.routeNote: From the MTSZ table (hops between neighbouring stamps); time excludes breaks, in the walking direction.

about.title: About Kéktúra tracker
about.description: An open-source progressive web app to track your hike along the National Blue Trail (Országos Kéktúra).
